Chapter by chapter

Our StoryNotre Histoire

Two lives, separated by thousands of miles, each following their own path — until, quietly, they didn't. Scroll sideways to turn the page.

Chapter I

Two Cities

Two lives, separated by thousands of miles, each following their own path.

1 / 11
Chapter II

The Wanderer

Enzo had always dreamed of travelling — of discovering the world, seeing new places, and finally turning those dreams into reality.

2 / 11
Chapter III

Her Own Story

Meanwhile, Sharmaine was raising her three children and living her own life.

3 / 11
Chapter IV

A Quiet Hope

She had always dreamed of a romance of her own — something genuine, a story worth living and sharing. But after the relationships she had been through, she had slowly stopped believing that a love like that would ever find its way to her.

4 / 11

And somehow, their paths began to draw closer.

Chapter V

The Map of Maybe

Enzo was looking at different destinations across Asia. He had always wanted to travel, and this time, he was simply comparing the possibilities before him.

5 / 11
Chapter VI

A Ticket to Somewhere

Flight prices varied from one destination to another. This time, the Philippines simply happened to be the most appealing opportunity.

6 / 11

So he chose the Philippines.

Chapter VII

The Smallest Decision

A simple decision. Almost insignificant. And sometimes, it is precisely the decisions that seem the smallest that end up changing an entire life.

7 / 11

Then came April 11, 2023. On a beach in Palawan, Enzo got down on one knee in front of Sharmaine. But he wasn't proposing — he was making a promise.

Chapter VIII

A Promise on the Sand

The next time he would kneel before her, it would be to ask her to become his wife. Nearly 1,000 days later, that promise would finally be kept.

8 / 11

Surrounded by his family and Sharmaine's, Enzo got down on one knee once again.

Chapter IX

The Question

This time, there was no promise for another day. There was only one question. Overwhelmed by emotion, Sharmaine could no longer hold back what she was feeling. Tears filled her eyes, and for a moment, words simply failed her.

9 / 11
Chapter X

The Answer

So she answered in the only way she could. She nodded. And a big yes, she said! No words were spoken. But none were needed.

10 / 11
Chapter XI

Hers

After everything she had come to believe about love, Sharmaine had finally found the love she had always dreamed of — and this time, it was hers.

11 / 11
